name: State Affairs
summary: State Affairs combines state-policy reporting, original data, and AI tools for institutions navigating regulation. It announced $70 million of total funding in July 2026; no valuation was disclosed.
overview: State Affairs provides real-time intelligence on legislation, regulation, hearings and political developments across all 50 states and the federal government. It combines reporting, data and AI tools for regulated businesses and institutional users.

bull_case: Regulatory complexity creates recurring demand for timely, trusted policy intelligence across large institutions.
bear_case: The business must defend differentiated reporting and data against established government-relations and information providers.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Policy-intelligence platform combining reporting, data and AI for regulated institutions.
company: State Affairs combines daily state-policy reporting, original data and AI tools for users who need to track regulatory and political change. Its coverage spans legislation, regulation, hearings and political developments across all U.S. states and the federal government.
The company announced $70 million in total funding in July 2026 to accelerate its intelligence platform. It did not disclose a valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Policy information is a high-value workflow for regulated industries. State Affairs is a private bet on combining journalism, data and AI into a more actionable regulatory-intelligence product.
